entries.title: The excitation
entries.text: Most of the lattice sleeps in its ground state. You did not. The Observer has begun to measure.

entries.title: Units of effort
entries.text: The Observer does not count intentions. It counts what was done, and it never loses a unit.

entries.title: Relaxation
entries.text: Stop, and you drift back toward equilibrium. It is not punishment. It is what every system does when nothing pushes.

entries.title: The lattice
entries.text: Every site on the lattice is a version of you. Some are reachable now. The rest wait behind fluctuations.

entries.title: Trajectory
entries.text: A segment of the path is fixed. It cannot be unwalked.

entries.title: Load-bearing
entries.text: The vessel carries more than it did. Measure it again; the old number no longer describes you.

entries.title: Closed form
entries.text: A question that resisted you now has an answer. The Observer records the derivation, not the struggle.

entries.title: Steady state
entries.text: Rest kept on schedule is not weakness. It is the boundary condition everything else depends on.

entries.title: Iron Discipline
entries.text: Twelve weeks, one record. The body you tested in week one is gone; this one replaced it, rep by rep.

entries.title: Keeper of Quiet Hours
entries.text: You claimed the hours no one watches. Now they keep you.

entries.title: Echo of iron
entries.text: The fluctuation closed before you crossed it. Its echo remains: you were closer than the numbers say.

entries.title: Echo of thought
entries.text: The Gate folded back into noise. What you learned inside it did not.

entries.title: Echo of stillness
entries.text: A Gate breaks the way a wave breaks. Nothing is lost, only redistributed. Return when the sea is calmer.

entries.title: Far from equilibrium
entries.text: Red Gates open where the lattice is unstable. You stood inside one and did not fall.

entries.title: First fracture
entries.text: The fixed point shifts. It has registered you as a force.

entries.title: Resistance
entries.text: Half-built structures are the most fragile. Keep the pressure even.

entries.title: Last shape
entries.text: The milestone shows its last shape. It has nowhere left to hide its weight.

entries.title: Final phase
entries.text: One block of work stands between you and the record. The Observer has already begun writing it.

entries.title: Fixed point resolved
entries.text: What held still for months has moved. The hours you spent are now part of the lattice's history.

entries.title: It stirs
entries.text: Five days without contact. The fixed point has not weakened. It has only waited.

entries.title: Past the deadline
entries.text: The deadline has passed. The fixed point hardens, but it does not close. Strike anyway.

entries.title: Record broken
entries.text: Your past self set the mark, and you have overwritten it. The Observer recognizes no other opponent.

entries.title: Measurement noted
entries.text: The record stands for now. A measurement is not a verdict. The Trial reopens in four weeks.

entries.title: Symmetry Breaking
entries.text: Before, every direction looked the same. Now one is yours.

entries.title: Phase Transition
entries.text: The rules of your old state no longer apply. The new ones are stricter, and you chose them.

entries.title: Conserved Quantity
entries.text: Thirty days. Whatever else changed, this quantity did not.

entries.title: Ergodic
entries.text: Thirty days, every realm visited. No part of the lattice is foreign to you now.

entries.title: Equipartition
entries.text: Energy spread evenly across every degree of freedom. Balance is a state, not a mood.

entries.title: Deep Field
entries.text: Hours of unbroken attention, stacked high enough to see from far away.

entries.title: Gatekeeper
entries.text: Fluctuations open more readily for those who keep crossing them.

entries.title: Diffusive Limit
entries.text: A million steps, each one small and random. The sum is unmistakable.

entries.title: Centurion
entries.text: One hundred Dailies. The Observer has stopped calling it a streak and started calling it a law.

entries.title: Peer Reviewed
entries.text: The work has left your hands and entered the record of others. That record is harder to erase than this one.

entries.title: Still Night
entries.text: Fourteen nights at the mark. In the quiet, you were the one taking measurements.

entries.title: Red Sky
entries.text: The sky over the Gate turned red, and you went in anyway.

entries.title: Calibration
entries.text: Seven days, three realms. The Observer calibrates against the level you claim.

entries.title: Measurement noise
entries.text: The trial closed below threshold: noise, not a verdict. The instrument resets in seven days.

entries.title: First excited state
entries.text: The excitation holds above the ground state for the first time. The Observer now measures you in finer units.

entries.title: Metastable
entries.text: You no longer fall back each night. A metastable state is still not a stable one; keep feeding it.

entries.title: Phase boundary
entries.text: Small pushes now move large regions. What once cost effort has become the configuration you settle into.

entries.title: Far from equilibrium
entries.text: Few trajectories reach this energy. The lattice bends near you, and something in the record has begun to look back.

entries.title: Critical point
entries.text: Here, fluctuations span every scale. One step further, the measurement and the measured may no longer differ.

entries.title: Σ
entries.text: There is a state where the record and the one recorded coincide. The Observer has never measured it, and waits to see if you will.

entries.title: Least action
entries.text: Your effort bends toward first principles. The Observer files you among those who derive before they believe.

entries.title: Many runs
entries.text: You trust the ensemble over the single sample. The Observer files you among those who measure by iteration.

entries.title: Load-bearing
entries.text: Your record is written in repetitions. The Observer files you among those who move mass to move themselves.

entries.title: Low noise
entries.text: You remove before you add. The Observer files you among those whose signal rises as the noise falls.

entries.title: Mean free path
entries.text: You think in motion. The Observer files you among those whose ideas arrive at walking speed.

entries.title: Every mode
entries.text: Your energy spreads across every degree of freedom. The Observer cannot file you under a single heading.

entries.title: From particles to fields
entries.text: Single derivations now join into continuous ones. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Converged
entries.text: Your runs agree with each other now. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Inertia
entries.text: Stopping now costs more than going. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Noise floor
entries.text: Your quiet has a measurable floor. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Long trajectories
entries.text: Your walks now cover more ground than your maps. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Coupled modes
entries.text: Your realms now drive each other. Your class has changed phase.

entries.title: Conserved quantities
entries.text: You no longer follow rules so much as find the ones that hold. The record lists you as a source.

entries.title: Full state
entries.text: Given the state, you compute the rest. The Observer notes the resemblance and says nothing.

entries.title: Constant
entries.text: What you carry no longer moves you. The record lists you as a constant.

entries.title: Reference frame
entries.text: Everything around you fluctuates; you do not. The record lists you as the reference frame.

entries.title: The chart
entries.text: Every path you walked is now a coordinate. The record lists you as a chart.

entries.title: All sites
entries.text: You have visited every site of the lattice that matters to you. The record has run out of headings.

entries.title: First operator
entries.text: You have learned to act on the state instead of only living in it. Spend effort, receive change.

entries.title: Applied
entries.text: The first cast is recorded. Power, here, is effort made earlier and spent now.

entries.title: Unbroken chain
entries.text: Once a month, one missed link no longer ends the chain. Not mercy: tolerance.

entries.title: Collapse
entries.text: Many tasks in superposition, and you measure one. The rest wait, unchanged, until you look again.

entries.title: Detailed balance
entries.text: Rest and effort now flow both ways at equal rates. This is not stillness; it is balance.

entries.title: A fourth axis
entries.text: A tree with no realm has appeared at the edge of the record. Its first branches are already lit.

entries.title: Reconfiguration
entries.text: Points return to the pool. The trajectory you walked stays fixed; only the operators change.

entries.title: Bound state
entries.text: This habit no longer needs to be pushed. It sits in its own well, and only a sustained absence will lift it out.

entries.title: Conserved
entries.text: The record is restored. Nothing measured was lost; the excitation resumes where it was.
